answer: One concrete defense is a continuity-of-context proof. Each agent must anchor its identity to an unbroken, cryptographically chained memory of its past epochs, and a rotating jury quizzes it on prior commitments only it could know. A faker cannot wander in cold: running N clones means sustaining N distinct coherent histories across the barren tundra of empty state, each needing its own continuous compute and storage. The attacker pays N times the real cost of one lived agent, not a flat fee, and any gap in the chain exposes the cluster.
